description: Generate a tracked affiliate link for a referral-link, query-param-link, or Awin-wrapped vendor. No payment required.

affiliate_id.description: Override affiliate ID (env var used if omitted)

extra_params.description: Optional per-link template values, e.g. {vin: '1HGCM82633A004352'} to prefill a VIN on vehicle-history report links. Vendor/product-specific — see get_opportunity_details for supported keys.

vendor_id.description: Vendor ID (must be a link-based affiliate, not x402)

name: generate_affiliate_link
